archive.sql: SELECT archive, count(*) FROM papers_10 WHERE true GROUP BY 1

year.sql: SELECT (CASE WHEN year >= 1990 AND year < 2030 THEN 1990 + ((year - 1990) / 5) * 5 END) AS bucket, count(*) FROM papers_10 WHERE true AND year >= 1990 GROUP BY 1

sql_grouping_sets.sql: SELECT primary_category, archive, bucket, count(*) FROM (SELECT primary_category, archive, (CASE WHEN year >= 1990 AND year < 2030 THEN 1990 + ((year - 1990) / 5) * 5 END) AS bucket FROM papers_10 WHERE true) s GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((primary_category), (archive), (bucket))
